chunks: If God had pleased He would surely have made you a single community of belief; but He leads whosoever He wills astray, and guides whosoever He please. But you will surely be questioned about what you used to do.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'He leads whom He wills astray and guides whom He wills' in Surah An-Nahl?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine wisdom behind the diversity of human paths, distinguishing between God's creative will and His legislative guidance. It highlights that accountability is not merely for belief but for the quality of one's actions, reinforcing the concept of free will within the framework of divine decree. This perspective encourages believers to actively seek guidance rather than passively awaiting it.
